Description must be at most 60 words of visible observations, no speculation or reasoning transcript. These are diagnostic observations, never owner approval. Exact edit action: Use the supplied approved image as the exact identity. Existing stylistic rust and wear remain even in intact state. Keep the complete subject and clear magenta margin; no background scenery.
